item.description:
Root Down is a 2-player abstract strategy game played on a standard 8x8 square game board.
The main mechanic is that all of a player's pieces flip from a state where they can move (kickers) to a state where they cannot move (roots) after every move. The kickers must also be next to a root in order to move, and the number of spaces they move is also determined by the number of kickers next to each root.

Root the Loot is a game for two players. One commands three moles on a midnight raid who must pick up as much loot as possible and return it to the safety of HQ. The other controls three ferrets who are guarding the loot and must capture the moles as quickly as possible.

item.description:
This French edition of the root game is a special edition which includes the base game and its expansion Riverfolk.
Root is a war adventure game in which players take on the role of one of four factions and fight to become the most powerful ruler of the vast Forest.
Root is a game that is played and told like a story. Players drive the narrative, and the differences between each role create a significant level of interaction and gameplay. Are you ready to fight for control of this vast wilderness?
PROGRESS OF THE GAME The game has the particularity of taking place in several rounds, themselves divided into 3 very distinct phases: Dawn The day Twilight During his turn, the player completes these three phases in order. Their turn then ends and the player to their left begins theirs. The three the phases are different depending on the faction played. A game can end in two different ways: A player scores 30 victory points A player complicit in a Domination card Each faction scores points in its own way:
The Marquise de Chat wants to exploit the Forest and use its abundant resources to fuel her economic and military empire. She scores points by constructing buildings in the Forest. The Canopy Dynasties seek to regain the glory of their former aristocracy and take back the Forest from the Marquise. They score points each turn by building and protecting perches in the Forest. The Forest Alliance wishes to unite the people of the Forest to rise against oppressors. She scores points by spreading sympathy for their cause throughout the Forest. The Wanderer seeks fame in the midst of this burgeoning conflict. He scores points by completing quests for the denizens of the Forest and helping or hindering other factions.

item.description:
Rediscover the Woodland with three brand-new factions and two new maps for Root!
Lilypad Diaspora Scattered long ago and suppressed ever since, the Lilypad Diaspora now hopes to call the Woodland home. While they work to integrate peacefully, peace is rare in the midst of civil war. As they train their warriors, they must ensure that their desire for safety does not tip into outright aggression. With weapons at the ready, a simple misunderstanding between the Diaspora and the Woodland can flare into vicious reprisals, hardening the Diaspora’s militancy and spreading resentment against their cause.
Twilight Council Sickened by the enduring conflict, the Twilight Council hosts assemblies to end the war, bringing together all the Woodland from the lowliest mouse-in-a-sack to the mightiest hawk with a royal claim. The assemblies emphasize political connections over pure numbers of warriors, pushing the factions away from bloody battle and toward heated debate. As the Council progresses in their mission, they can declare edicts to change how the assemblies work, manipulating their enemies’ incentives and actions.
Knaves of the Deepwood Nobody really knows how the Knaves of the Deepwood got together, but the myths are many. From the treeline these miscreants and ne’er-do-wells sally forth, raiding barracks and baggage trains and making off with warriors in tow as hostages. Why? For ransom, that’s why. Some say they give the proceeds to the needy. Some say they spend it lavishly. Either way, their celebrations ring out through the night, the music swelling from the forest depths where few dare to go.
